BOP PayPak Debit Card. The Combined KFS (conventional) prices PayPak at PKR 1,850 for issuance/renewal/replacement with supplementary 'NA' - the same KFS line that supplies the Classic (2,800), Gold (3,600), Platinum (6,000) and World (18,000) figures used by the other BOP records in this dataset, so this card is on the same verified vintage as its siblings.

PayPak is a distinct product at BOP, not a Mastercard variant: the Debit Card Application Form (Conventional) offers 'Domestic Payment Scheme (PayPak)' and 'International Payment Scheme (MasterCard)' as mutually exclusive selections, and states that the PayPak card is a domestic scheme card usable only in Pakistan.

bop.com.pk is behind Imperva/Incapsula and returns a JS challenge to plain HTTP clients; the SOBC PDFs must be fetched through a real browser session. The PDFs' text layer also separates the card-name column from the charges column, so the tables must be read from a page render rather than extracted text.

Provenance: Re-verified 2026-09-08 against the current half-year Schedule of Bank Charges, read directly from the PDF published on bop.com.pk (page rendered and read visually, because the document's text layer splits the card-name column from the charges column and cannot be paired reliably). bop.com.pk serves an Imperva/Incapsula challenge to plain HTTP clients, so the document was retrieved through a real browser session. Salary, balance and age remain null where BOP publishes nothing.

gaps: BOP publishes one eligibility grid for all consumer credit cards on view.aspx?id=3373 (min income PKR 20,000-50,000 by applicant category, age 18 to 60/70), not per card tier; salary is modelled at the lowest published floor (PKR 20,000, salaried with salary transfer to BOP).
BOP does not publish minimum or maximum age criteria for debit cards on card pages or the SOBC.

Salary-transfer and income-document requirements are not surfaced as structured fields on public BOP card pages; the credit-card grid only distinguishes a 'Salaried - Salary Transfer' category (PKR 20,000).

The Jul-Dec 2026 SOBC (Section T-9) removed the BOP@Work salary-tier debit-card waivers; PayPak/Classic/Gold/Platinum issuance and renewal are now free for all BOP@Work accounts (KHAAS Platinum for priority-marked customers only). These are recorded under annual_fee_waiver_rule.

The Jul-Dec 2026 SOBC lists credit cards not modelled here (Mastercard Business Rs. 5,000, Executive Business Rs. 12,500, Lahore Qalandar Executive Business Rs. 12,500, BOP Green, Corporate, and a new Mastercard World Elite Credit Card at Rs. 50,000 basic / Rs. 50,000 supplementary); World Elite has no product page yet, so it was not added.

Fee history: an H2-2025 SOBC temporarily cut card pricing, Jan-Jun 2026 reverted it, and Jul-Dec 2026 raised most debit-card fees (Classic Rs. 3,000, Gold Rs. 4,000, World Rs. 20,000, Lahore Qalandars Rs. 3,500, Naaz Rs. 2,700) and the Platinum (Rs. 15,625) and LQ Business (Rs. 6,250) credit-card fees.
